```{python}
#| label: setup
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from itables import show
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# REPLACE: load real data here
# df = pd.read_csv("data.csv")
# df = pd.read_parquet("data.parquet")

# Sample data
dates = pd.date_range(end=datetime.now(), periods=90, freq='D')
df = pd.DataFrame({
    "date": dates,
    "revenue": [200_000 + i*1500 + (i%7)*8000 for i in range(90)],
    "orders":  [12 + (i // 3) for i in range(90)],
    "segment": (["Жилые","Коммерческие","Социальные","Промышленные"] * 23)[:90],
})

# KPI computations
total_revenue = df["revenue"].sum()
total_orders = df["orders"].sum()
avg_order = total_revenue / total_orders
yoy_growth = 0.226  # placeholder
```

## Row {height="50%"}

### Динамика выручки

```{python}
fig = px.line(df, x="date", y="revenue", template="plotly_white")
fig.update_traces(line=dict(width=2.5, color="#3B82F6"), fill="tozeroy", fillcolor="rgba(59,130,246,0.1)")
fig.update_layout(
    margin=dict(l=20, r=20, t=20, b=20),
    xaxis_title=None, yaxis_title=None,
    font=dict(family="Inter, system-ui", size=12),
    hoverlabel=dict(bgcolor="white", bordercolor="#e5e5e5"),
)
fig.show()
```

### Структура по сегментам

```{python}
seg = df.groupby("segment", as_index=False)["revenue"].sum()
fig = px.pie(seg, names="segment", values="revenue", hole=0.6,
             color_discrete_sequence=["#3B82F6","#8B5CF6","#EC4899","#F59E0B"])
fig.update_traces(textposition='outside', textinfo='label+percent')
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=20, r=20, t=20, b=20), font=dict(family="Inter, system-ui"))
fig.show()
```

## Row {height="30%"}

### Топ-10 заказов

```{python}
top = df.nlargest(10, "revenue")[["date","segment","orders","revenue"]].copy()
top["date"] = top["date"].dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
top["revenue"] = top["revenue"].apply(lambda v: f"₸ {v:,}".replace(",", " "))
show(top, classes="display compact", paging=False, searching=False, info=False)
```
